content: Convolution applies a small matrix called a kernel over an input matrix by sliding it across local regions.
source: OpenTutorAI mock lesson: Image Processing / Convolution

content: At each position, the kernel values are multiplied with the corresponding input patch values, and the products are summed to produce one output value.
source: OpenTutorAI mock lesson: Image Processing / Convolution

content: A simple visual explanation can use a 2x2 kernel sliding over a 3x3 matrix to show how local patches are transformed into output values.
source: OpenTutorAI mock visual explanation: Kernel Movement

content: Overfitting happens when a model learns the training data too specifically and performs poorly on unseen data.
source: OpenTutorAI mock lesson: Machine Learning / Overfitting
